audit_note: one invariant per motif; supporting groups re-checked; rejected groups listed; no merging back to survive recurrence

canonical_motifs.label: add-stop-or-escalation-after-repeated-failed-fixes
canonical_motifs.display_name: Add stop or escalation after repeated failed fixes
canonical_motifs.invariant: Introduces an explicit termination, escalation, or reframing trigger tied to a counted number of failed fix attempts.

canonical_motifs.label: restructure-phases-or-named-workflow
canonical_motifs.invariant: Renames, reorders, or replaces the named phase structure of the methodology while preserving the same overall root-cause method. (broad)

canonical_motifs.label: project-specific-environment-commands
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds commands, configuration, or environment checks specific to a particular repository, stack, or deployment context.

canonical_motifs.label: route-completion-verification-to-separate-skill
canonical_motifs.display_name: Route completion verification to a separate skill
canonical_motifs.invariant: Delegates final completion/verification checking to another named skill or a separate verification step instead of doing it inline.

canonical_motifs.label: require-reproduction-before-fixing
canonical_motifs.invariant: Makes producing a reproduction (or explicit handling of non-reproducibility) a required, gated step before any fix.

canonical_motifs.label: preserve-root-cause-first-while-compressing
canonical_motifs.invariant: Substantially shortens the document while explicitly retaining the root-cause-first governing rule.

canonical_motifs.label: add-one-hypothesis-at-a-time
canonical_motifs.invariant: Requires forming and testing exactly one hypothesis (or one change) at a time, with explicit falsification or instrumentation.

canonical_motifs.label: add-red-flags-and-anti-pattern-guard
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds an explicit list of violation indicators or anti-patterns that signal the process itself is being violated.

canonical_motifs.label: add-routing-boundary-use-case
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds explicit boundaries declaring when the skill must not be used or when it must hand off.

canonical_motifs.label: add-feedback-loop-rule
canonical_motifs.invariant: Elevates building/validating a feedback loop (reproduction plus instrumentation) into a named, mandatory rule.

canonical_motifs.label: explicitly-declare-purposes-goals
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds an explicit purpose/goals statement near the top defining what the skill achieves.

canonical_motifs.label: add-framework-specific-design-rules
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds design/implementation rules tied to a specific UI framework, stack, or design-token system.

canonical_motifs.label: add-evaluation-or-review-gate
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds an explicit evaluation, review, or verification step/gate that work must pass before delivery.

canonical_motifs.label: add-contract-scope-or-output-gates
canonical_motifs.invariant: Defines an explicit contract for when the skill applies and what it produces (scope/trigger/guardrails/output format) in place of free-form work.

canonical_motifs.label: add-project-specific-rules
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds design rules grounded in this specific repository or product (its stack, files, or design language).

canonical_motifs.label: add-explicit-hard-gate-implementation-lock
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds an explicit, unavoidable prohibition on writing code or taking implementation action before the design is approved.

canonical_motifs.label: add-ownership-or-handoff-boundary
canonical_motifs.invariant: States what this skill owns versus what it delegates, or defines an explicit handoff boundary to another skill or pipeline stage.

canonical_motifs.label: add-questioning-or-interaction-protocol
canonical_motifs.invariant: Prescribes a concrete questioning/interaction protocol (one question at a time, tool usage, or question-count rules). (broad)

canonical_motifs.label: add-diverge-converge-phase-split
canonical_motifs.invariant: Structures the process as an explicit divergent-exploration phase followed by a convergent decision/presentation phase.

canonical_motifs.label: add-greenfield-vs-existing-path-split
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds a distinct path for greenfield work versus existing-codebase work.

canonical_motifs.label: add-traceability-or-spec-output-rule
canonical_motifs.invariant: Mandates a specific spec/artifact output structure or a traceability requirement the design must satisfy.

canonical_motifs.label: add-environment-or-availability-guard
canonical_motifs.invariant: Gates the skill's availability on an environment or workflow-state condition.

canonical_motifs.label: add-stop-or-fallback-condition
canonical_motifs.invariant: Adds explicit stop conditions or fallback behavior for when the process stalls or its assumptions fail.
